## Update Available!
Made a mistake? You can now delete entries from any of your trackers and edit quantities with ease. Just head to the Insights page for any tracker and select ‘All Data’ to view, update quantities, or remove your tracking data.
changelog:
## What's new in AmaraHealth™?
Made a mistake? You can now delete entries from any of your trackers and edit quantities with ease. Just head to the Insights page for any tracker and select ‘All Data’ to view, update quantities, or remove your tracking data.
